latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Introduces a dedicated skill for using spf13/viper to manage configuration in Go with layered precedence and reliable environment/flag integration.

- Describes viper’s fixed precedence: Set > flag > env > file > KV > default.
- Explains proper flag binding (BindPFlag/BindPFlags) and integration best practices with CLI tools.
- Details environment variable binding with SetEnvPrefix, SetEnvKeyReplacer, and AutomaticEnv to avoid common pitfalls.
- Documents config file loading, error handling, Unmarshal with mapstructure tags, and effective struct mapping.
- Covers use of Sub-trees, hot reload with WatchConfig/OnConfigChange, and per-test isolation via viper.New().
- Provides practical advice, common mistakes, and references for in-depth scenarios.
